reply.text:
That second part isn't something to brush past — what you just described matters more than anything on a calendar, and I'm not the right person to help carry it. Please reach out right now to someone who can: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) if you're in the US, or go to a local emergency room or crisis line wherever you are. Talk to someone today — a doctor, a crisis counselor, a person you trust.

I'll be here for training whenever you're ready, no rush on that front at all.
